claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_bonus_action_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Bonus Unarmed Strike grants the ability to make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action — not an extra standard action. grant_extra_action covers extra standard actions and its restriction field excludes action kinds, but there is no atom for 'grant a bonus-action-constrained attack of a specific strike type'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Bonus Unarmed Strike. You can make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: set_minimum_damage_die
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Martial Arts Die replaces the normal damage die of Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons with a specific die (1d6 at L1, scaling by monk level). No existing atom substitutes the damage die of an attack rather than adding a numeric bonus or changing a scaling tier. The v4 scale_die_size atom scales an existing die but cannot establish a replacement base die for a specific strike type.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Martial Arts Die. You can roll 1d6 in place of the normal damage of your Unarmed Strike or Monk weapons. This die changes as you gain Monk levels.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_substitute in types.ts (ability substitution variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: modify_roll_substitute is listed in the v4 taxonomy (TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md §9) but is absent from types.ts. Dexterous Attacks is a canonical ability-substitution rider: use Dex instead of Str for attack and damage rolls of Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons. Adding this v4 atom to the surface would cover it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Dexterous Attacks. You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate: unarmed_or_monk_weapons_only
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The gate requires the monk to be unarmed OR wielding only Monk weapons (Simple or Light Martial Melee). No existing EquipmentPredicate variant expresses this disjunction. The wielding_weapon predicate covers a single weapon-kind and has no 'unarmed' mode.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain the following benefits while you are unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons and you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate: not_wielding_shield
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The gate also excludes wielding a Shield. The existing not_wearing_armor covers armor categories; shields are wielded off-hand and have no equivalent predicate in the current vocabulary.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_substitute for save DC (Grapple/Shove)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Dexterous Attacks also allows Dex instead of Str to determine the save DC when the monk uses Grapple or Shove options of their Unarmed Strike. This is an ability substitution on the DC computation side, not on a d20 roll kind — a further shape beyond the attack/damage roll substitution.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: when you use the Grapple or Shove option of your Unarmed Strike, you can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to determine the save DC.
